name: 84043 · Lehi, UT
findings: ZIP 84043 (Lehi) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84043 (Lehi) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84043 (Lehi) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 102 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
